offering_description.value: Provides lease-to-own and installment financing for consumers who lack access to traditional credit. Works through retail and e-commerce partners selling furniture, electronics, appliances and auto parts, and offers buy-now-pay-later plans through its Four Technologies segment, using technology-driven approval and servicing.

primary_services.value: lease-to-own financing; point-of-sale installment financing; buy-now-pay-later payment plans

customer_segment.value: B2C: credit-challenged consumers leasing or financing goods; B2B: retail and e-commerce merchants that partner for financing

end_markets.value: retail; furniture and mattresses; consumer electronics; appliances; automotive parts and services

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: lease payments and fees on leased merchandise; interest or premiums: interest and fees on loans and BNPL plans; service fees: merchant fees on financed purchases
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; interest or premiums; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: buys merchandise from retail partners and leases it to consumers, provides financing; software / platform: digital point-of-sale and app-based financing platforms for merchants and consumers

geography_served.value: US national: United States retail partner locations and online merchants across most states

specialization.value: related lines: lease-to-own and BNPL/installment financing for underserved consumers

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: third-party retailers and e-commerce merchants offering financing at checkout; online: direct-to-consumer apps and websites for financing

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer lending and lease regulation by CFPB, FTC, and state lease-to-own and licensing laws

notes: Segment details may have changed since my knowledge was last updated.
